For glitch-free screen-off USB Exclusive playback, we recommend 3 steps:

1. Enable Battery Optimization Whitelist (Unrestricted) on this page.
2. Allow background activity & auto-start for Sonify in system app info.
3. Lock the Sonify card in Recents to prevent one-tap memory cleaners.
